cohort: SHANGHAI_D4 author-reported close, 2024 and 2025; source frozen before download
candidate_selection: minimum equal-cell development mean across seeds17,29,43 for pooled KCM hidden32 shrink1 lambda in[1,100], uncapped only; ties prefer lambda1
baseline_selection: minimum development full-view score among pooled priceGRU16/shrink.1 (3 seeds), pooled LSTM32/shrink1 (3 seeds), local priceGRU16/shrink1 (3 seeds), D2-best common PatchTST width/shrink config (seed17), D1-best pooled ridge (seed17), RW, original statistical reference. No per-market hyperparameter cherry-picking.
prequential_note: 2025 may train on matured Shanghai2024 observations by frozen calendar rule. 2024 scores never alter configurations, cutoffs, or training rules; other 3 markets remain the<=2023 development files.
primary_effect: equal-year/horizon average (candidate seed-mean squared loss - baseline seed-mean squared loss)/RW-MSE; not seed-ensemble predictions
primary_inference: stratified-by-year paired circular moving-block bootstrap, primary block40observations,10000resamples,seed20261019; same indices across all models/seeds/horizons; recalculate RW denominator each draw
one_sided_p: centered bootstrap null of no improvement; Holm correction over two prespecified primary comparisons
positive_evidence_requires: both primary effects negative and Holm-adjusted p<.05 at block40; all chosen baselines and mechanistic ablations disclosed. This statistical condition is necessary evidence, not a journal acceptance guarantee or sufficient proof of novelty.
other_data: Other author2024 suffixes remain development. LNCEA and ScienceDBprocessedmeans not silently merged into primaryclose pool.
limitations: Single new confirmation market/source; incomplete observedquote calendar; non-overlap or resampling never guarantees stationarity or independence.
